description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Customs Ordinance Order under Section 19 A
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 19(A) of the Customs Ordinance, providing exemptions from customs import duties. It establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for duty waivers on specific imported goods, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, and the primary content is regulatory in nature concerning customs laws and exemptions.
